name: zreader_read_node
description: zReader_ReadNode reads scalar and array zrd nodes from an opened archive-backed file.
tier_s_evidence: The fixture smoke verifies ReadNode through LoadNodeFromPath on an archive-backed zrd stream. The retail ZRDR smoke parses known .zrd members from support/zbd/zrdr.zbd and support/zbd/m1/zrdr.zbd. VC5SP3 COFF byte comparison for 0x48d080 now passes with zero unmasked mismatches over the full 320-byte retail body range, including the post-retail-ret npad, switch jump table, and trailing NOP padding.
